base_rows.text:

Dear [Manager's Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

My name is [Your Full Name], and I am currently working at your organization as part of my role in our team. - You will be granted up to three days' paid annual vacation.
- Your employer may also provide additional unpaid sick leave if necessary due to personal circumstances such as illness or injury during your tenure here.

Please let me know how much notice you would like before applying for these benefits so that they can proceed smoothly according to established procedures.
